name: Ostriches
overview: Scripture references ostriches in a variety of contexts, sometimes translated as "owls" in the King James Version but clarified as "ostriches" in the Revised Version, highlighting the challenges of ancient Hebrew bird identification (Leviticus 11:16; Deuteronomy 14:15). The book of Job provides detailed insight into the ostrich's nature, describing its wings and feathers and its unusual behavior of leaving eggs exposed in the earth, neglecting their protection despite the risk of destruction (Job 39:13-15). This portrayal underscores God's sovereign design over creation, including the seemingly careless but purposeful ways of the ostrich.
